# <span id="aanchor362"></span> Report/Export Scheduling

Automatic scheduling and emailing reports or exports requires the Scheduled Reporting module. Administrators must have **System Process – Report Scheduler – Can Schedule** privileges, granted from the [User Access](../../Settings%20Manager/Security/User%20Access.md) or [Group Access](../../Settings%20Manager/Security/Group%20Access.md) screen.

Use the Schedule Editor screen to create report and export schedules. Schedules are processed by the Reports service, and are then emailed, printed, or saved to a file on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.

Before creating schedules, see: [Configure Report/Export Scheduling](Configure%20Report-Export%20Scheduling.md).



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 514;height: 272;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Schedule Editor Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Schedule Editor screen:

- **Name** - Name used to identify the schedule

- **Schedule Type** - Designates whether the schedule is for reports (default) or exports.

- **Run Frequency** - Defines how often the report schedule will run (daily, weekly, or monthly). For weekly frequency, select the day of the week; for monthly frequency, select the day of the month. For example: A schedule that should run on the 1st of every month, would be set to Monthly, 1st.

- **Run Time** - Defines the time of day the report schedule will run. For example: A schedule that should run on the 1st of every month at 10:00am would be set to Monthly, 1st, 10:00:00 AM.

- **Data Set Dates** - Defines the time frame or period the report will run for. For example: A schedule that should run every month on the 1st for the prior contract month would be set to Previous Contract Month. Data Set Date options are as follows:
  - **Month to Date** – The beginning of the current month up to the current date. For example: If today is October 23, the data will be from October 1 at midnight to October 23 at the current time.
  - **Last Full Month** – Data starting on the first of the previous month and ending on the first of the current month. For example: September 1, 12:00 AM through October 1, 12:00 AM.
  - **Last Full Week** – Data starting at midnight Sunday and ending on the following Sunday at midnight. For example: Sunday, October 15 12:00 AM through Sunday, October 22 12:00 AM.
  - **Previous X Days** – A specified number of days prior to the current date. For example: previous 30 days.
  - **Current Contract Month** – The beginning of the current contract month to the current date. For example: If today is October 25, the contract day is 2 and contract hour is 8, the data will be from October 2, 8:00 AM through October 25, at the current time.
  - **Previous Contract Month** – The beginning of the previous contract month to the end of the previous contract month. For example: If today is October 25, the contract day is 2, and the contract hour is 8, the data will be from September 2, 8:00 AM through October 2, 8:00 AM.

- **Group** - A list of reports and report groups that you can select to schedule.

- **Export Flags** - This option is only available when the schedule type is set to "Exports". Export flags are only used if the export has been coded to accept these values. Different export flag options are supported by each export. Review the documentation for each export format to see what options are supported. If an export format supports export flags and no values are entered in this field or a blank is given where a character is expected, default flag values will be assumed.

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Common tags">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Common Export Flags</a>

  <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="Common tags">

  - **Data Resolution (H, D, or M)** - Indicates data resolution; H = hourly, D = daily, M = monthly.
  - **Data Level (M or L)** - Indicates the data source; M = meter data, L = location data.
  - **Rounded or Fractional (R or F)** - Determines the precision for applicable exported values. R = whole (rounded) numbers, F = fractional values before rounding.
  - **Character 4: Measured or Standard Units (M or S)** - M = measured unit values, S = standard unit values.

  </div>

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="GasTextFileExchange">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />GasTextFileExchange Export Flags</a>

  <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="GasTextFileExchange">

  - **Character 1: Data Resolution (H, D, or M)** - If this flag is left blank, it defaults to D.
  - **Character 2: Data Level (M or L)**
  - **Character 3: Rounded or Fractional (R or F)** - If this flag is left blank, it defaults to F. If this flag is set to F, the number of decimal places is defaulted to 6.
  - **Character 4: Measured or Standard Conditions (M or S)** - M = measured conditions, S = standard conditions. If this flag is left empty, it will default to M.
  - **Character 5: Enforce Time Trails Time Stamp (Y or N)** - Y is equivalent to checking the Enforce Time Trails Time Stamp option on the GasTextFileExchange Export screen; N is equivalent to not having the option checked. If this flag is left empty, it will default to Y. (See: [Exports](../Exports.md#FcTextFileExchange))

  </div>

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="LiqTextFileExchange">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />LiquidTextFileExchange Export Flags</a>

  <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="LiqTextFileExchange">

  - **Character 1: Data Resolution (H, D, M, or B)** - Hourly, Daily, Monthly, or Batch. All other values will default to "D".
  - **Character 2: Unused -** Set to "X".
  - **Character 3: Unused -** Set to "X".
  - **Character 4: Measured or System Units (M or S)** - Measured or System. All other values, including null values, will default to "M".

  **Example:** Export flags "BXXS" will output batch-level data at system units.

  </div>

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="SourceAnalysisExport">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />SourceAnalysisExport Export Flags</a>

  <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="SourceAnalysisExport">

  - **Character 1: Process Standalone Sample Analyses within Date Range (Y or N)** - Y is equivalent to checking the Process Standalone Sample Analyses within Date Range option on the Export screen; N is equivalent to not having the option checked. If this flag is left empty, it will default to N.
  - **Character 2: Enforce Time Trails Time Stamp (Y or N)** - Y is equivalent to checking the Export Last Record only option on the Export screen; N is equivalent to not having the option checked. If this flag is left empty, it will default to N. (See: [Exports](../Exports.md#SourceAnalysisExport))

  </div>

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="StndTIPS Export">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />StndTIPS Export Flags</a>

  <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="StndTIPS Export">

  - **Character 1: Data resolution (D or M)** - D = daily, M = monthly. This flag is set to D by default.
  - **Character 2: Measured or standard units (M or S)** - M = measured unit values, S = standard unit values. This flag is set to M by default.
  - **Character 3: Include auto estimated data (Y or N)** - This flag is set to N by default.
  - **Character 4: Output meter number designation (M, A, or C)** - M = meter number, A = alternative meter number, or C = customer meter number.

  </div>

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="StndFieldInsights Export">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />StndFieldInsights Export Flags</a>

  <div class="drop-down" style="background-color: #ffffff; display: none;" mc-target-name="StndFieldInsights Export">

  - **<span id="StndFieldExportFlags"></span>Character 1: Data output (A, D, P, or M)** - A = all three, D = daily volumes, P = daily pressure, M = monthly volumes. This flag must be specified for a schedule to be processed.
  - **Character 2: Measured or standard units (M or S)** - M = measured unit values, S = standard unit values. This flag is set to M by default.
  - **Character 3: Data to export (A, C, or N)** - A = all data, C = current volume different from original, N = new and changed records. This flag is set to N by default.

  </div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Function Buttons">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Function Buttons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Function Buttons">

The following functions are available on the Schedule Editor screen:

- **Run Now** - Click this button while in view mode to queue the selected schedule to be processed by the Reports service at the current date and time.

  The schedule will also continue to run at the configured date and time.

- **Reports** - This button only displays when the schedule type is set to "Reports". When you select a report group from the Group drop-down, click the **Reports** button next to the drop-down to see the reports included in the selected group.

- **Exports** - This button only displays when the schedule type is set to "Exports". When you select an export group from the Group drop-down, click the **Exports** button next to the drop-down to see the exports included in the selected group.

- **Data** - Configure report selections (parameters). Examples are: meter, list, measured/standard, original/current, and decimals. These parameters will vary by report. Selecting a report group will include the parameters for each report in the group.

  When scheduling a report group, you can click the **Replicate Data** button to use the same parameter value across all reports in the group. For example: You have created a schedule for four reports that all have a parameter called "Number of Decimals". If you set the parameter to "0" for one report and click the **Replicate Data** button, the parameter will be set to "0" for the other reports in the group.

- **Email** - Specify recipients for emailed scheduled reports.

- **Files** - Save scheduled reports to a file.

- **Printers** - Send scheduled reports to a printer.

- **New** - Create a new schedule.

- **Edit** - Edit an existing schedule.

- **Delete** - Delete an existing schedule.

- **Save** - Save changes made to the schedule.

- **Cancel** - Discard changes made to a schedule.

- **Exit** - Close the Schedule Editor screen.

- **Print** - Preview the scheduled report with the details specified.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Schedule">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Create a Schedule</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Schedule">

Individual reports/exports or report/export groups can be scheduled to run automatically.

<div class="procedure">

To create a schedule:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Scheduling**.

2.  Select a schedule type (Reports or Exports).

3.  Click **New**.

4.  Enter a name for the schedule.

5.  Select the run frequency, run time, data set dates, and group options.

    If you have a custom report or export that is not available from the Group drop-down, see: [Add Report](../Add%20Report.md) or [Add Export](../Add%20Export.md).

6.  Define export flags, if applicable.

7.  Click the **Data** button to launch the Data Editor and define report data parameters. From within the Data Editor, double-click each row in the grid (or select a row and click **Edit**) to populate each parameter value.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 598;height: 333;" />

8.  Click **OK** to exit the Data Editor.

9.  Click the **Email**, **Files**, or **Printers** buttons to configure the schedule delivery method. Multiple delivery methods can be selected. For example: A scheduled report can be emailed and printed.

10. Once the schedule has been configured, click **Save**.

11. Go to **Reports** \> **Status** to review the next scheduled run and status of the report/export schedule.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Email">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Email Reports/Exports</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Email">

Scheduled reports or exports can be emailed to one or more contacts or email distribution groups.

To email an export, a file output must also be configured. (See: <a href="#Files" class="notelink">Files</a>) If you email a report or export group consisting of more than one report/export, a separate email will be generated for each report/export.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 383;height: 294;" />

The following items are available on the Report Email Editor screen:

- **To** - Email recipient(s).

  Recipients must exist as contacts in FLOWCAL and must include valid email addresses.

- **File Format** - The file type for the emailed report (see: [Crystal Export Types](../Crystal%20Export%20Types.md)).

- **Subject** - Subject line for the scheduled report email.

- **Message** - Body of the scheduled report email.

- **Compress Report Files** - Enable this option to compress the files into a .zip file before emailing them.

</div>

<span id="Files"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Files">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Files</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Files">

Scheduled reports or exports can be saved to file.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 539;height: 314;" />

The following items are available on the File Distribution Editor screen:

- **Directory** (or **File** for exports) - Directory where scheduled report/export will be saved.

  This path is relative to the computer FLOWCAL is running from. If you want a report written to your local computer, you will need to browse to the location on your computer; otherwise, the Reports service will write the file to its own D:\\ drive. For schedules, this path is relative to the computer where the service is running.

  When emailing an export, the Directory field must include the name of the file and file extension; otherwise, FLOWCAL will just create the file in the directory specified, and the export will not be emailed.

- **File Format** - Several options are available for report schedules, such as PDF. (See: [Crystal Export Types](../Crystal%20Export%20Types.md))

- **Output File Naming Options** - Define text to append or prepend to the file name, or use one of the following variables:
  - **%RUNDATE%** - The time stamp for the export using a MM-DD-YY HH-MM-SS (24-hour) format
    <div class="example">

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Run Date">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

    If the run date is August 2, 2017, at 3:07:08 pm, the variable will translate to "08-02-17 15-07-08".

    </div>
  - **%SCHEDNAME%** - The name of the schedule
  - **%RPTMONTH%** - The name of the reporting month

- **Meter Reports** - Select an output file configuration option. By default, FLOWCAL creates one file for meter reports.
  - **Output Common File** (default) – Export one file for the selected meter(s)
  - **Output Individual File per Meter** – Export a separate file for each meter
  - **Output Individual File into Meter Directory** – Export a separate file and directory for each meter

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Printers">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Printers</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Printers">

Scheduled reports or exports can be sent to a printer. Only printers defined within Output Printers of the Report Configuration screen will be listed in the drop-down. (See: [Configure Report/Export Scheduling](Configure%20Report-Export%20Scheduling.md))



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 390;height: 241;" />

</div>
